question:
Identify the part containing a grammatical or structural error: 

Neither the Principal, nor the teachers was present.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence contains a subject-verb agreement error in **part 3**.
 
• The phrase "**Neither the Principal, nor the teachers**" uses a correlative conjunction "Neither... nor," which determines the subject and verb agreement.
 
• When "Neither... nor" connects two subjects, the verb should agree with the subject closer to the verb.
 
• In this case, "**teachers**" is plural, so the verb should be "**were**" instead of "**was**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Neither the Principal, nor the teachers were present."*
